summary.text: Kelly Grappe is the Democratic nominee, a corporate learning-and-development executive and White County farm owner who says her key messages are serving the people rather than a political party, transparent election administration and modernizing the Secretary of State's office.

paragraphs.text: More than 30 years leading organizations, beginning at Alltel and later Verizon, where she led an 800-person customer service organization; now head of learning and development at a multi-state dental support organization.
Lives on a family farm in White County; says she has worked with Arkansas's initiative and referendum process and on civic education.
